Title: Aditya's Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Siya - 13 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Hema - 36 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Sharda - 66 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Aditya stands by the road. Hema, Siya and Sharda stand near him.]

Aditya: "What lovely weather!"

[Aditya gets on the bus.]

Aditya (gently): "Okay, Grandma."

[Aditya gets off the school bus.]

Siya: "I knew it!"

[Aditya hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Aditya: "Exactly right."

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Aditya stands in the park. Siya and Hema stand near him.]

Aditya: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya does push-ups.]

Siya: "Mom, listen!"

[Aditya does yoga on a mat.]

Siya: "Yes, all right."

[Siya skips rope.]

Siya (gently): "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Thick fog lies all around. Aditya stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Aditya: "Look over here."

[The mist slowly clears.]

Aditya: "That's great!"

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Hema and Sharda stand near him.]

Sharda: "Let's begin."

[Aditya lies down on the sofa.]

Aditya (happily): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Aditya sits down on a chair.]

Hema: "Let's see."

[Aditya flops down on the sofa.]

Aditya (softly): "That was such a fun day!"
